trump-ukraine-mostly-soldiers-die.text:
Sunday: a Russian drone kills six civilians in a Ukrainian park, including a baby in her stroller.
Tuesday, Trump: "Some people die in a town that got hit or whatever, but mostly soldiers die."
Or whatever. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-ukraine-mostly-soldiers-die/

Trump says America got "nothing back other than high diesel" from Ukraine. Ten days ago he lifted sanctions on Russian diesel. The only diesel in this story came from the guys with the drones. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-ukraine-mostly-soldiers-die/
The president's full statement on dead Ukrainian civilians is two words: "or whatever." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-ukraine-mostly-soldiers-die/
